role: Low-cost point lookup for NPI, provider name, taxonomy, mailing/practice addresses, and organization records.
freshness: Daily query path for targeted lookups.
pipeline_use: Use for identity anchoring, NPI validation, baseline address/name/specialty evidence, and lightweight refreshes.
risk: NPI issuance does not prove license/credential validity, so never use NPPES alone for license status.

role: Bulk refresh of FOIA-disclosable NPPES provider data.
freshness: Monthly full replacement plus weekly incrementals.
pipeline_use: Maintain a local searchable NPI cache; ingest practice-location, other-name, endpoint, and deactivation references.
risk: Large files require batch ingestion and schema/version monitoring.

role: Detect deactivated NPIs and avoid stale identities.
freshness: Monthly deactivation file and weekly incremental updates.
pipeline_use: Route deactivated/reactivated NPI evidence to high-priority review unless corroborated by authoritative status sources.
risk: CMS warns deactivated NPI records should not be used in standard transactions.

source: CMS Provider Data Catalog / Medicare Care Compare
role: Doctors, clinicians, groups, practice locations, affiliations, and public profile context.
freshness: CMS states general profile information such as addresses and phones is updated monthly.
pipeline_use: Cross-check group affiliations, locations, demographic fields, and Medicare-facing profile data.
risk: Some profile changes may take months to propagate from PECOS; do not treat as the sole real-time source.

role: Fastest public signal for moves, phone changes, location closures, rebrands, accepting-patient status, and direct patient-facing contact info.
freshness: Crawl with per-domain cache TTL and change detection.
pipeline_use: High-value evidence for phone/address/status updates; use deterministic extraction first and LLM fallback only for messy pages.
risk: Scraping constraints, duplicate locations, marketing pages, and stale pages require robots/legal review and citations.

role: Authoritative license status, discipline, inactive/retired signals, and credential confirmation.
pipeline_use: Primary authority for license_status and safety review routing.
risk: Fragmented schemas, different access terms, and state-specific identifiers require adapters.
